title: Start a Time Machine backup
summary: Manually start a Time Machine backup from the command line. You can choose to wait for it to finish or let it run in the background.

steps.explain: Start a backup in the background. The command returns immediately, and the backup continues running.

alternatives.explain: Start a backup and wait until it is completely finished before returning control to the terminal.

rollback.explain: If you started a backup and want to stop it, run this command.

warnings: Starting a backup may use significant disk I/O and network bandwidth if backing up to a network drive.
